# GitHub Copilot instructions

The instructions for this repository live in **[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)** at the repo
root. Read that file — it is the single source of truth for every AI tool used here, so
there is nothing to keep in sync.

Then, before writing anything that touches money, splits or balances, read
[`docs/data-model.md`](../docs/data-model.md). The invariants there are load-bearing and are
not visible from the code alone.
